summary: Diff adds certificate verification route/page, admin certificate list/editor UI with an admin gate, QR rendering utilities, and client-side PDF generation. Backend adds certificate DTO types and a migration module, but the diff summary is truncated for backend/main.mo so several backend acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed from the provided evidence. There are also unrequested changes around a secret-token-based access-control initialization and modifications to an immutable frontend hook file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin set/management approach is defined and implemented (e.g., initial admin bootstrap and ability to manage admin principals). Backend rejects create/update/admin-list operations for non-admin callers with a clear error.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show any backend methods for managing admin principals (add/remove/list admins) or explicit authorization checks on certificate create/update/admin-list operations. The only visible auth-related evidence is inclusion of authorization mixins and an initialization call from the frontend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate a unique, non-guessable public verification token per certificate and provide a public lookup API keyed only by that token.
missing_requirements.reason: While DTO includes `uniqueToken` and frontend calls `getCertificateByToken(token)`, the diff summary does not show backend implementation that generates a non-guessable token (e.g., randomness) and exposes the public token-only lookup endpoint. The shown backend snippet includes a sequential `certificateCounter`, but token generation is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: When Expired, show the specified warning text prominently: “⚠️ Refilling Due – Please Contact Authorized Service Provider”.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI displays the warning split across title/description without the exact required combined text (it shows “⚠️ Refilling Due” and “Please Contact Authorized Service Provider” on separate lines, and without the en dash).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend persistence for certificate records with upgrade-safe stable storage; preserve existing inquiries data across upgrades; add/update migration only as needed.
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module was added, but the diff summary does not provide evidence of stable variables and `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` (or equivalent) logic in `backend/main.mo` to actually persist certificates and preserve inquiries across canister upgrades.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret URL-parameter-based access control initialization using `caffeineAdminToken` and storing/reading secret parameters from the URL/session.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires Internet Identity principals-based admin authorization and explicitly forbids editing certain immutable frontend hook paths. The diff introduces a secret-token mechanism and modifies `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` (an immutable path per constraints), which was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend user profile APIs (get/save caller user profile) unrelated to certificate management.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest scope is certificates + verification + PDF and preserving existing inquiry endpoints; user profile management is not requested.
